"We are looking for reflections!" The Erienne shrieked to the squad. "Relics are usually shiny, if you spot one go nearer and see if you can sense a wiff of power."

"In any case, always descend low enough to verify what it is. Your overseer will note the location and what it looks like." The overseer nodded. "Never touch a relic!" The Erienne shrieked. "Relics are dangerous. You are to report each sighting to the Chaplains. The Chaplains will verify it's authentic and will decide what to do with it."

Ver-u as always was impressed by the Erienne. So orderly so certain in her resolve. She wished, as all schryke, to soon prove orderly and strong enough to gain rank. For this training course she hadbeen dead set on discovering a real relic. Many trinkets and locations had been spotted, so far however no Schryke had spotted a relic the Chaplains had verified as authentic.

If she could find a relic, she would be the first Schryke to do so. It might fast track her to become an Erienne.

The course continued and the Erienne and Overseer demonstrated how to fly and land without disturbing the air, a soft flight was key to going unnoticed and a soft landing was important to not disturb the relics.

-------

Several months into their training they had lost a few underwarriors who had succumbed to the toll of th Heavy Training grounds. Her training was still ongoing, so far she had shown strong enough to maintain flight in the heavy places.

On this day, right after training at the heavy place, they set out on a scouting mission. She loved it, she flew so fast and her beating wings felt so strong after leaving the heavy place. In her excitement and eagerness she finally spotted her first reflection. She shrieked alertness and [started stooping down](https://i.sli.mg/09FKSF.jpg). The flock followed and she was allowed to land at first. The Erienne and Overseer warned her to land cautiously.

She did. Slowly stepping closer to what she had spotted. [It was a multifaceted, very intricate ball.](http://media-cache-ak0.pinimg.com/736x/1d/63/84/1d6384e883fae8b9346cc97d66f6ec88.jpg) It was nooked between a branch of a tree.

Eager and excited she kept staring. She was certain. This was the real deal. She could sense it. Her flock noted and took off to continue scouting, the Erienne shrieked at her to comply.

Too forcefull, for all her excitement and her wings still strong from the morning training, she caused a big gust at takeoff. She watched the relic come loose from it's position and roll on the forest floor. As multifaceted as it was it kept rolling for a while.

The whole Flock of Shryke stayed aloft in the air looking petrified at Ver-u. Ver-u had panicked and stopped flapping. She fell, her face close to a mossy root.

She saw the dice rolling towards her.

Right before her eyes, against the mossy root, the relic came to a halt.
